verdict: A difficult week — leads dropped sharply and cost per lead doubled.
narrative: This period you received 8 leads on $1,850 in spend, with cost per lead reaching $231 — a 110% jump week-over-week driven by a near-complete shutdown of organic search and Google Business Profile activity between September 23–25, when both channels recorded zero actions for three consecutive days. That organic silence removed demand that paid ads alone cannot replace. Several setup milestones — including heating campaign toggles, the financing page, and the Homer Glen branch — are overdue and are being prioritized now to restore the full funnel before the heating season opens. Heating campaigns on Google and Meta are scheduled to go live October 1, with supporting content indexed by September 30; once those are in place, lead volume should recover and cost per lead should normalize.
